summary: Agent 0.32.0. ADR-0085: before every start the agent checks who besides SYSTEM/Administrators/TrustedInstaller (Windows: owner + DACL) or root (Linux: owner + mode) could change a child's program, its folder or a folder above, and refuses the child unless children[].user_writable_reason accepts it; check-config fails for a refused child, so the self-update gate keeps the running version; agent/Move-OllamaProtected.cmd moves a per-user Ollama child into C:\Program Files\Ollama with verification and restore. ADR-0084: Linux unit runs the binary from /opt/skirnir-agent (link in /usr/local/bin), ProtectSystem=strict, ProtectHome=read-only, CapabilityBoundingSet=CAP_SYS_ADMIN (GPU power limit) behind SystemCallFilter=@system-service; setup moves an existing node and restarts it.

findings.evidence: The agent (LocalSystem) started its Ollama child from the per-user install folder, which that user owns; any process of the user could replace ollama.exe or a library and run as SYSTEM on the next start.
findings.resolution: childExposure checks program, folder (incl. add-file for library planting) and every folder above (delete-child, DAC, owner); untrusted owner counts; inherit-only skipped; deny ignored (over-report only). Supervisor refuses, rechecks every minute, failed check refuses too. Verified on a real node: per-user Ollama refused (owner named), Program Files\Git and System32\cmd.exe accepted.

findings.evidence: Linux unit allowed writes to /usr/local/bin (first on PATH): a compromised agent could plant commands root or users run; ProtectSystem=full left /var, homes writable; full capability set incl. CAP_SYS_ADMIN could remount.
findings.resolution: Binary in /opt/skirnir-agent; ProtectSystem=strict, ProtectHome=read-only, only CAP_SYS_ADMIN, SystemCallFilter=@system-service. On a systemd host: only the three folders writable in the service namespace, CapBnd = CAP_SYS_ADMIN, seccomp active; a transient unit with the same restrictions could not remount / (control without the filter could and then wrote /etc).

findings.evidence: A refused child after an automatic update would take a node's Ollama away.
findings.resolution: check-config of the new binary fails for a refused child; the updater runs it before swapping, so the node keeps the running version and the order fails with the refusal line as reason.

findings.evidence: Move-OllamaProtected.ps1 runs elevated, rewrites the agent configuration and restarts the service.
findings.resolution: Checks before acting (admin, service, exactly one Ollama child with one cmd line, source exposed, target protected by the same rule, target empty or same version); each step names its failure; any failure restores the configuration backup, removes a copy it created and restarts; transcript next to the script; pure parts tested under PS 5.1 and 7. No secret handled or printed.

tests.command: go test ./... (Windows and Linux/WSL), gofmt -l, go vet (linux, windows)
tests.evidence: ok on both platforms; new childpath_test.go and setup_linux_test.go cases.

tests.command: skirnir-agent check-config with children in the per-user Ollama folder, Program Files\Git, System32\cmd.exe (Windows node)
tests.evidence: refused only the per-user Ollama, owner named, exit 1.

tests.command: WSL Ubuntu as root: old layout, new setup, namespace probes, remount with and without filter
tests.evidence: service active from /opt, GPU via nvidia-smi, only /opt/skirnir-agent, /var/lib, /var/log writable; CapBnd 0x200000; remount denied with filter, allowed in the control run; systemd-analyze security 2.7; all files cleaned up.
all passed under PowerShell 7 and Windows PowerShell 5.1.
All checks passed; ADR index ok: 85 ADRs.

limitations: Only the program and the folders on its path are checked, not every file below the program folder nor script arguments.
Move-OllamaProtected.ps1 has not run on a production node yet (it needs administrator rights there; the operator runs it).
CAP_SYS_ADMIN remains for the Linux GPU guard, contained by the system call filter.
